_method: Bar geometry read out of the figure's vector content stream and converted with the axis calibration from its gridlines. Not computed from results/ -- there is no Gemma probe run in this repo, so these values cannot be regenerated here and nothing checks them against source data.
_validation: The same extraction reproduces the Olmo, Llama and Apertus bars of that figure to the precision stored in em_class_shift.json (e.g. medical/layperson Olmo +19.00 +/-3.92), so the readout itself is exact.
